question: When did the Chauri Chaura incident take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1922.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chauri Chaura:-**

 
 
• The​ incident took place on** February 4, 1922,** in the Chauri Chaura village of **Uttar Pradesh**, India.
 
• It was a violent clash between the** Indian protesters and the British police**, which resulted in the** death of 22 policemen and three civilians.**
 
• The incident led to the suspension of the **non-cooperation movement** launched by Mahatma Gandhi, as he believed that the **violence** was against the principles of non-violent protest.
 
• The Chauri Chaura incident is considered a turning point in the Indian freedom struggle as it shifted the focus from** non-cooperation to civil disobedience movement.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1901:-**

 
 
• **Indian National Congress** was first held in **Calcutta. **
 
 
 
• **1915:-**
 
 
• **​** It is an important year in Indian history as it marks the beginning of the **First World War**, which had a significant impact on India's struggle for freedom.
 
 
 
• **1908:-**
 
 
• **​**In this year the** Khudiram Bose, a Bengali revolutionary, **attempted to assassinate a British judge, which further fueled the Indian freedom struggle.
